title: デビュー戦の後に・最初のご褒美

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wanting to protect me from any embarrassment, Super Creek finishes her debut with a majestic run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides to take on the Classics, choosing to run in the Sumire Stakes next because of its adorable name.
